title: Photorealistic cinematic street-style po
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic street-style portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, standing casually beside a glass-enclosed bus stop on a busy urban street in Taiwan. Captured from a slightly elevated, close-range perspective, looking gently downward toward her, with a spontaneous, intimate smartphone photography aesthetic.

She has a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a petite tapered chin, a refined jawline, a small straight nose, and naturally full, softly rosy lips forming a subtle, playful smile. Her smooth, fair skin has warm ivory undertones, delicate natural texture, and softly luminous highlights. Her large, dark brown almond-shaped eyes feature fine eyeliner, subtly defined lashes, and natural catchlights. She playfully winks one eye while keeping the other open and looking directly into the camera, creating a charming, cheerful, slightly mischievous expression.

Her thick, glossy black hair is styled into two low, loosely gathered side buns near her jawline, with soft wispy strands framing her face. Straight, airy bangs fall across her forehead, gently separating above her eyebrows. A few loose strands around her ears and temples add a natural, slightly windswept appearance.

She has a slender, naturally curvaceous figure, a clearly defined waist, graceful shoulders, and naturally full, proportionate bust contours. She wears a fitted, dusty-blue ribbed halter-neck crop top with a high, softly folded mock neckline, wide-open shoulders, deep side armholes, and a snug silhouette that follows her natural curves. The cropped hem reveals a narrow strip of midriff. A delicate silver necklace with a small heart-shaped pendant rests against the front of her top.

Her outfit is completed by dark indigo denim jeans with visible contrast stitching, belt loops, and front pockets, accented by a pale lavender fabric waistband detail. An off-white canvas tote bag hangs from her right shoulder, its long straps falling beside her torso. Both arms rest naturally along her sides, with her shoulders slightly drawn backward and her body angled subtly toward the camera.

Behind her, the bus shelter features green-tinted glass panels, vertical metal supports, posted transit schedules, and simple wooden-and-metal benches. The foreground contains dark gray interlocking sidewalk pavers, scattered dry leaves, and small patches of greenery. Beyond the shelter, an asphalt roadway, white traffic markings, parked vehicles, storefronts, and weathered urban architecture create a believable Taiwanese streetscape.

Soft overcast daylight provides even illumination, gentle facial shadows, realistic skin tones, and subtle reflections on the glass. Shot with a 24–28mm equivalent wide-angle smartphone lens, natural perspective distortion, moderately deep depth of field, authentic environmental detail, restrained HDR, subtle film grain, realistic fabric textures, and cinematic color grading with muted urban grays, cool teal reflections, warm skin tones, and rich denim blues. Candid editorial realism, anatomically natural proportions, lifelike detail, no artificial skin smoothing, no exaggerated features, no illustration, no CGI. Aspect ratio 4:5.
